name: Kurogane Jin
source:
Element: Iron
Rank: 純壱位
Hobby/Skill: Going to zoo

The Acting Commanding Officer of Elemental Defense Headquarters. Although being an Iron Shikenkan takes a heavy physical toll on the body, he has been fighting on the front lines for 10 years.
He is well taken care of and trusted as a dependable superior officer, but is easily influenced by his emotions.
His real family is a big one.
